resources.string: Alarm: %1$swecker 6:30 Training reads the time on the device (also 7 Uhr, halb acht, 6pm) and opens your clock app with a new alarm and the remaining words as label. The clock app shows it; it is set only when you confirm it there. Only hour and minute are handed over: a day word cannot be set and is shown as ignored.
Open a new alarm in the clock app: %s
The clock app sets the next %s; the typed day was not handed over.
Type a time, e.g. %1$swecker 6:30 Training or %1$swecker halb acht

Timer: %1$stimer 10 min Pasta reads the duration on the device (also 90 s, 1:30, 1 h 20, half an hour; German, English, Spanish; at most 24 hours) and opens your clock app with a new timer and the remaining words as label. The clock app shows it; it starts only when you confirm it there.
Open a new timer in the clock app: %s
Type a duration of at most 24 hours, e.g. %1$stimer 10 min Pasta or %1$stimer 1 h 20
